paragraphs: Rabbi Yishmael, son of Rabbi Yehoshua.
Mentioned in Vayikra Rabbah 11:8. At the end of Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 7:6, Rabbi Matanyah said, “I went up and heard Rabbi Yochanan and Rabbi Yishmael, sons of Yeshua,” etc.[^1][^2]

notes.text: סלקית ושמעית means “I went up and heard,” spoken by Matanyah, not two personal names. The consulted paragraph adds “for business” after “went up”; that detail is not added to Hyman’s abbreviated quotation. Yehoshua in the heading and Yeshua in the quotation remain distinct forms.

The checked Vayikra Rabbah 11:8 has Rabbi Avin reporting Rabbi Yishmael berabbi Yehoshua. Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 7:6 has Rabbi Matanyah saying that he went up for business and heard Rabbi Yochanan and Rabbi Yishmael, sons of Yeshua. Hyman’s shorter quotation omits “for business”; it is not added to his body text. Yehoshua and Yeshua remain source-specific forms, without a genealogical binding.
